summary: Spread control pods across worker nodes with topology_spread_constraints and set limits summing to the node's resources; if only limits are set, requests equal limits, so set requests lower (for example 25% of the node). The example for 4-CPU, 16 GB nodes uses 250m/1Gi requests and limits of 1000m/4Gi for web and redis and 2000m/4Gi for task.
questions: What resource requests and limits should I set for controller on 4 CPU 16GB nodes?
What happens if I only set limits on controller containers?

answer_card.title: Example controller resource sizing (4 CPU, 16 GB nodes)
